claims.assertion: Alfrateans and Antarians are humanomorphs, not Pleiadians; Alfrateans are Centaurian and Latin-appearing.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She defines humanomorphs as visually indistinguishable from humans, unlike broader humanoid categories.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says Nordic-looking contactees often report Pleiadians because many have been active and New Age programming primes that label.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: Swaruu alleges regressive species use Nordic holograms or clones to impersonate them and assign blame.
claims.speaker: Swaruu

claims.assertion: She says the Cabal uses New Age Pleiadian imagery to discredit Taygetans and their message.
claims.speaker: Swaruu
